notes.title: 『Crimzon Clover World EXplosion』＆『Castle of Shikigami 2』NOW AVAILABLE！
notes.content:
We've added two new SHMUP titles to the DEIGCA GAMES catalog, and we hope you will enjoy it! If you like SHMUP, then you shouldn't miss out!

[b][h3]『Crimzon Clover World EXplosion』[/h3] [/b]

After one year of its release on Nintendo Switch, "Crimzon Clover World EXplosion"  will be making its long-awaited debut on Steam!

★Price: $19.99 (10% off launch discount: $17.99)

★Special discount for 『WORLD IGNITION』 users 
If you have a copy of "Crimzon Clover WORLD IGNITION," you will automatically receive a 40% loyalty discount when you purchase "World EXplosion" during the following period. By adding up the launch discount, you can purchase "World EXplosion" at a maximum of "50%OFF." 

Take this chance to experience the best SHMUPS title! 

Special discount period: December 7, 2021 - June 7, 2022

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1718160/

▽Launch Trailer[previewyoutube=956XrCwP3RU;full][/previewyoutube]

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ 

[h3][b]『Crimzon Clover World EXplosion - Complete Soundtrack』 [/b][/h3]

This soundtrack includes both the ORIGINAL and ARRANGED tracks of "Crimzon Clover World IGNITION"
※The contents are the same as the soundtrack for "WORLD IGNITION," so please be careful not to buy a duplicate if you already own it.

★Price: $7.99 (10% off launch discount: $7.19)

[b]※Will be available soon※[/b]

You can purchase the game and soundtrack all at once with a great bundle value. 

★Price: $25.18 (save $2.52 over purchasing them individually)

[b]※Will be available soon※[/b]

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ 

[h3][b]『Castle of Shikigami 2』[/b][/h3]

The second installment of the dramatic shooter that gained popularity in the arcades is now coming to Steam with +α elements!

★Price: $19.99 (10% off launch discount: $17.99)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1556650/
▽Launch Trailer[previewyoutube=-FFTKqaBoVs;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition to the game itself, there are some special items specially prepared for Shikigami fans!

[h3][b]『Castle of Shikigami - Series Bundle』[/b][/h3]

This is a special bundle (10% off) that includes "Castle of Shikigami" and "Castle of Shikigami 2". Customers who already own "Castle of Shikigami" will only have to pay for "Castle of Shikigami II", so you can save even more than usual!

▽If you own "Castle of Shikigami" and want to purchase "Castle of Shikigami 2"
$16.19 (save $3.8 over purchasing the game individually )

▽For new users who purchase both games at the same time
$26.98

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23980

Battler material
Face Material
Walking Sprites
Standing Image 
Extra: 4 BGMs from "Castle of Shikigami 2" in m4a/ogg format

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832590/

RPG Maker MZ empowers you with simple tools to create your RPG right out of the box, yet is customizable enough to make the exact RPG you want! We are planning to update it to version 1.4.0 soon.

The editor will be able to handle data that is compatible with RPG Maker MV animations.
Improved performance of particle animation playback by updating Effekseer version.

notes.title: Balance Changes (Ver 1.17121801)
notes.content:
Details of the balance adjustments included in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/574160/announcements/detail/1574437108307728272]today's update[/url] are included below. 

[h1]Shared Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Strengthened Offensive Unit ability (adjusted no. of shots and shot speed)
[*]Increased amount Armor Drain ability heals.
[*]Increased Explosion ability's affect time and decreased its reload time.
[*]Increased Super Charge ability's affect time.
[*]Using a BOSS beam attack now drains BOSS Mode armor gauge (just as in Duo).[/list]
[h1]Lev[/h1]
[list][*]When in BOSS Mode, opponent will now turn to face Lev's BOSS.
[*]Reduced close-range damage (charge gauge).[/list]
[h1]Henri[/h1]
[list][*]Minor adjustments to hit and completion timing of Bullet Canceller, and AOE of wind pressure[/list]
[h1]Ursure[/h1]
[list][*]Increased durability of BOSS parts
[*]Increased hitstun for M attack (napalm)[/list]
[h1]Chang Po[/h1]
[list][*]Reduced close-range damage (charge gauge).[/list]
[h1]Cuilan[/h1]
[list][*]Increased damage (armor gauge) of normal shots for M attack.
[*]Increased damage (armor gauge) for both S attack and barrage "Roll Bomb"
[*]Reduced damage (especially to charge gauge) of barrage "Orbital Laser"[/list]
[h1]Hongo[/h1]
[list][*]Increased charging time for M attack
[*]Added recovery time post Bullet Canceller
[*]Reduced damage of S attack.[/list]
[h1]Fabian[/h1]
[list][*]Adjusted rotation speed of S attack (slight increase)
[*]Increased durability of barrage attack "Blitz Arrow"[/list]
[h1]Shinobu[/h1]
[list][*]Increased durability of S attack (mine)
[*]Increased damage of main shot (wave)
[*]Increased damage of main shot (standard shot)
[*]Adjusted launch timing (sped up) of barrage "Formation Attack" and increased durability of units.
[*]Increased damage (charge gauge) of alpha cartridge barrage "Sagittarius 2"
[*]Increased damage (armor gauge) of standard shots launched after barrage "Sagittarius 2" lands.
[*]Adjusted BOSS Mode's formation change attack (behaviour and increased damage)[/list]
[h1]Theo[/h1]
[list][*]Removed ability to dash-cancel into bullet canceller (during mode change).
[*]Increased BOSS Mode M attack damage (armor)[/list]
[h1]Luca[/h1]
[list][*]Adjusted homing ability at close range for barrage attack "Hayate" (Alpha > Beta)
[*]Increased damage (charge & armor gauge) of barrage "Hayate" and "Tsumuji"[/list]
[h1]Ranatus[/h1]
[list][*]Increased damage (armor gauge) of M attack (dash)
[*]Increased damage (armor gauge) of barrage "Trio Sonata"
[*]Increased damage (armor) of missiles fired during M attack and Trio Sonata.
[*]Changed beam attack (B) to fire for a fixed length of time (removed ability to extend this by holding down the button)
[*]Added recovery time after firing beam attack (B) [/list]
[h1]Mika[/h1]
[list][*]Increased durability of S attack (homing missile) and also damage (charge & armor gauge) caused by post impact explosion.
[*]Increased durability of purge unit.[/list]
[h1]Ernula[/h1]
[list][*]Changed beam attack (B) to fire for a fixed length of time (removed ability to extend this by holding down the button) and reduced movement speed during use.[/list]
[h1]Sakurako[/h1]
[list][*]Increased durability of S attack (mine).
[*]Added ability to move and dash-cancel during barrage "Scorpio".
[*]Increased napalm explosion size during dash for barrage "Scorpio".
[*]Increased damage (armor gauge) of standard shots launched after barrage "Sagittarius" lands.
[*]Increased rotation speed for barrage "Fear Volley".[/list]
[h1]Karel[/h1]
[list][*]Increased laser damage (armor gauge) for barrage "Retsu".
[*]Increased damage (armor gauge) of napalm explosion after missile lands in barrage "Sen" and "Ougi".[/list]
[h1]Lili[/h1]
[list][*]Changed S attack so homing lasers are launched once a unit has been destroyed.[/list]
[h1]Valken[/h1]
[list][*]Reduced napalm damage (charge & armor gauge).[/list]
[h1]Temjin[/h1]
[list][*]Adjusted reach of close-range attack.
[*]Reduced movement and dash speed.
[*]Reduced damage (armor gauge) of M attack.
[*]Decreased S attack damage (armor gauge) and increased damage (charge gauge).
[*]Added recovery time after firing BOSS beam.
[*]Stopped rotation when firing BOSS Mode hyper beam (F Laser).[/list]

notes.title: 12/20 Update: Lobby, balance, keyboard and more (Ver 1.17121801)
notes.content:
Today's update includes the following:

[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Lobby functionality added[/b]
Accessed via Player or Ranked matches: start to look for an opponent, then use X button to open a lobby and choose an opponent. The icon next to the player name shows their connection speed.
[*][b]Ability select added for Valken and Virtual On DLC[/b]
This works the same as with other characters, but will not change the operator.
[*][b]Extensive balance changes[/b]
[strike]Details in a separate post coming later.[/strike]
Details [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/574160/announcements/detail/1574437108308072275]here[/url]!
[*][b]Added ability to change keyboard controls[/b]
This is offered via an .ini file found in the installation directory. Open it with a text editor, change the controls to suit you then save the file before running the game. NB: we are unable to support this function, so please use as is.
[*][b]Minor bug fixes[/b]
[/list]

Abilities select screen (Valken):
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28839815/aab331d7aeabdefe9bc6958ccf7f88b041d762f8.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28839815/06280baf2262593031cfef41c3403c77719fd724.jpg[/img][/url]

Lobby:
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28839815/44a52537003aa45135951c1bd0132f9128c099e6.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28839815/99daccff4c2fa3b5a7757785c28b023ba78f74c2.jpg[/img][/url]

As always, if you have any problems, please feel free to report them [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/574160/discussions/0/1474222499229293822/]here[/url].

Thanks for playing Senko no Ronde 2!

notes.title: Virtual On and Valken join the fray!
notes.content:
You read it right, today marks the release of two new DLC rounders for Senko no Ronde 2.

notes.title: 10/03 Update: Balancing improvements and network fixes
notes.content:
Thanks to all your reports we've been able to address several balancing issues, including one which was affecting network play. Details, as always are below.

[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with some PCs where sound effects were not playing
[*]Fixed an issue which may have switched host and guest in an online match
[*]Fixed an issue where the key guide was not displaying correctly on the character select screen when using a Direct Input controller 
[*]Fixed an issue where using B.O.S.S. Mode in close quarters would  momentarily disable the other player
[*]Fix for Karel's B.O.S.S.Mode spawning without arms if activated after having its arms destroyed
[*]Added a short period of invulnerability when firing a Hyper Beam
[*]Napalm attacks no longer cause knockbacks and can now be guarded using barrier.
[*]Fixed DLC characters leaderboards (Lili & Karel)
[/list]

If you find any other issues, please report them [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/574160/discussions/0/1474222499229293822/]here[/url].
In particular, if you have any online issues which can be replicated, we're looking into fixes now so any additional information is appreciated.

Thanks for playing Senko no Ronde 2!

That's right, we have two new pilots; Lili and Karel, and their rounders, Azureus and Brinsta, along with a voice pack including new taunt voices for all the characters.

Lili and Karel can be used in any mode except Story and can be selected by moving the cursor all the way to the right when choosing a pilot.

Rounder: Brinsta
M (Main): Pochette Launcher *1
S (Sub) : Twin Tail *2
B (Barrage) : Waltz of the Dragonfly
←→→+B: Rondo of Fate, Chapter 1
←←→+B: Rondo of Fate, Chapter 2
360 + B: Dance of Fear *3

*1 Hold M button to charge.
*2 Formation changes depending on action at launch. Launches Homing Lasers after a set amount of time.
*3 Barrage varies dependent on direction controller is rotated.

Directions: Movement
Direction + A: Moving attack 
M: Main Shot
S: Homing Laser
B: Sword

http://store.steampowered.com/app/698224/Senko_no_Ronde_2__Rounder_Karel/

B.O.S.S. Mode: Tenka-Daiittou
Directions: Movement
Direction + A: Moving attack
M: Attack Form
S: Defence Form
B: 
A+M+S: Extermination Attack (Final B.O.S.S.)

notes.title: Differences between Senko no Ronde 2 & DUO
notes.content:
For players of the previous installment or those curious, here is a quick rundown of the changes made.

DUO
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28839815/0c32157d78b24146dd68e67ac5a99e2e1905cf67.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28839815/e664197fbe8b44261f1ca43a7131a9ed28ee033a.jpg[/img][/url]

Senko 2 (international art)
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28839815/855b8942894a9d7cce567affb3fb6e17502a27cb.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28839815/399a546d8298876a37cdf658a61e896d37f00547.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Overall[/h1]
[list]
[*]More bullets/effects & gameplay has been sped up.
[*]Removed 'parameter strengthening' partner type.
[*]Streamlined the partner system: now pilot and partner are preset.
[*]Melee combo attacks now favour the person who hits first (simultaneous hits will cancel each other out).
[/list]

[h1]Extra Abilities[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added an ability to each partner, giving a wider range to use.
[*]Abilities can now be used multiple times in one round (once gauge has recovered).
[/list]

[h1]Shot[/h1]
[list]
[*]Removed compulsory reload allowing for continual fire.
[/list]

[h1]Barrier/Shield[/h1]
[list]
[*]Barrier now provides full protection from all but a few attacks (beams & napalm).
[*]Main melee attack and Bullet Canceller attacks can now be guarded.
[/list]

[h1]Charge Gauge[/h1]
[list]
[*]Gauge can now be recharged by picking up items as well.
[list][*]Items are dropped when doing damage to an opponent or destroying enemy projectiles/drones etc.
[*]Using Bullet Canceller to cancel an opponent's attacks also drops items.[/list]
[*]Once gauge is empty, your mech overheats disabling barrier, Barrage Attack and B.O.S.S. mode.
[/list]

[h1]Melee Attacks[/h1]
[list]
[*]Adjusted melee attack motions so they would 'home in' on an opponent and thus connect easier.
[*]Normal Bullet Cancellers can be cancelled into a dash.
[/list]

[h1]B.O.S.S. Mode[/h1]
[list]
[*]Removed bonus to Armour Gauge after exiting B.O.S.S. mode.
[*]Removed reduction to armour gauge when using an SP attack in B.O.S.S. mode.
[/list]

Via developer G.Rev's [url=http://www.grev.co.jp/blog/archives/818]official blog[/url] (Japanese only).

Removed compulsory reload allowing for continual fire.

[*]Streamlined the partner system: now pilot and partner are preset.
[*]Melee combo attacks now favour the person who hits first (simultaneous hits will cancel each other out).
[/list]

[h1]Extra Abilities[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added an ability to each partner, giving a wider range to use.
[*]Abilities can now be used multiple times in one round (once gauge has recovered).
[/list]

[h1]Shot[/h1]
[list]
[*]Removed compulsory reload allowing for continual fire.
[/list]

[h1]Barrier/Shield[/h1]
[list]
[*]Barrier now provides full protection from all but a few attacks (beams & napalm).
[*]Main melee attack and Bullet Canceller attacks can now be guarded.
[/list]

[h1]Charge Gauge[/h1]
[list]
[*]Gauge can now be recharged by picking up items as well.
[list][*]Items are dropped when doing damage to an opponent or destroying enemy projectiles/drones etc.
[*]Using Bullet Canceller to cancel an opponent's attacks also drops items.[/list]
[*]Once gauge is empty, your mech overheats disabling barrier, Barrage Attack and B.O.S.S. mode.
[/list]

[h1]Melee Attacks[/h1]
[list]
[*]Adjusted melee attack motions so they would 'home in' on an opponent and thus connect easier.
[*]Normal Bullet Cancellers can be cancelled into a dash.
[/list]

[h1]B.O.S.S. Mode[/h1]
[list]
[*]Removed bonus to Armour Gauge after exiting B.O.S.S. mode.
[*]Removed reduction to armour gauge when using an SP attack in B.O.S.S. mode.
[/list]

Via developer G.Rev's [url=http://www.grev.co.jp/blog/archives/818]official blog[/url] (Japanese only).

notes.title: 9/8 Update: A fix to the online controller pairing bug
notes.content:
[b]Bug description: [/b] 
If you played online and you are NOT the host of the match, your controller button mapping was paired to your Player 2 controls.  This would result in the player being forced to play using the default button mapping even if you had re-mapped your Player 1 controls.  The workaround was to have a second controller plugged in and to re-map those controls.

This bug has been fixed and both hosting player and non-hosting player's controls will reflect the controls that have been mapped to one's Player 1 configuration.

If you find any other issues, please report them [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/574160/discussions/0/1474222499229293822/]here[/url].
